recommendation: Tail is 23, one point above the previous assessment and still below the block threshold. headline: NQ drifts back toward its post-PMI low as the 10-year holds above 5%, though the session low still stands
body: The hot 13:45Z flash PMI (composite 58.4 against 55.2 consensus, manufacturing 57.0, services 58.7) continues to drive a hawkish rate repricing rather than a growth rally. At 16:28Z NDX trades 30,428.74, down 0.99%, having opened at its 30,706.23 high, fallen to 30,353.88, recovered to roughly 30,519 and then faded back to within 75 points of the low. NQ futures show the same shape near 30,745 against a 30,642.75 low. The decisive structural fact is that the session low has now stood for close to three hours through a full bounce-and-fade cycle: mean reversion is still functioning, which is what Tail measures, so Tail rises only one point to 23 and stays inside the watch band. The amplifier stack is nonetheless the heaviest of the week. The 10-year yield is 5.08%, just under its 5.09% session high and the highest since 2007, while the 2-year is 4.90%, up about 15 basis points, and the 30-year touched 5.37%. Fed Governor Barr said further policy adjustments are likely to be needed, and October hike pricing sits near 70%. WTI is up 2.1% at $92.41 with Brent near $102.63 as Strait of Hormuz supply constraints persist, adding an inflation-side impulse to the same repricing. Semiconductors lead the downside with SOX off 1.87% and NVDA at its session low. Set against that, VIX is only 14.84 against a 14.21 previous close, and a 0.99% index decline is a modest realised move for this backdrop, which is why Stress at 54 is far above Tail at 23. The narrow danger window covers the 17:00Z five-year auction and the power hour into the 20:00Z close, where a second rate-driven impulse would first become visible.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours divide cleanly at the 13:45Z flash PMI. From the 16:00Z hour on 22 September through 11:00Z today, Tail held between 10 and 21 in a quiet regime that shifted from trend-up during the prior US session to normal overnight, with Stress easing from the low-40s to the low-30s. Conditions firmed from 12:00Z as mode turned mixed, the 14:00Z hour recorded the break with Tail 25, Stress 54 and dominant mode trend-down, and the 15:00Z hour stepped back to Tail 22 as the first retracement held.
outlookSummary: The near-term path turns on whether the 30,353.88 session low continues to hold. Tail is carried at 23 to 24 through the 17:00Z five-year auction and the power-hour window, then steps down through the 20:00Z cash close as the intraday impulse mechanism is removed. Overnight conditional Tail settles in the low teens with dominant mode normal, before rising again into Thursday's 12:30Z jobless claims and the 13:30Z cash open, where any second rate-driven impulse would first become visible. Apart from the current clock-hour, none of this structure is observed; it is stated conditionally.
